platforms.windows_wpf_legacy: excluded from this task; not migrated or accepted

preserved: existing application request fingerprints and lock namespace
same business transaction for result and receipt
legacyAdapters: FinanceApplicationOperationJournal delegates the shared mechanism and preserves its old envelope
chart manual and finance cost input receipts retain their existing domain-specific tables/fingerprints; no old receipt is rewritten

response.path: client API path beginning /finance/, without /api prefix
response.requestBody: new configuration HTTP commands retain the exact supplied object, including omitted versus explicit null fields; normal callers supply all required fields and requestId. Trusted typed calls retain their established body. Client compares JSON deeply without relying on key order
response.notFoundMeaning: No committed actor-owned receipt is visible. This does not prove no write; keep the original frozen command and retry only that request.
response.replay: Same actor/id/method/path/body returns the immutable original outcome even after others change current state. Different actor, operation, path or body cannot reuse that ID.

commands.result: original actual posting snapshot; amountLocal remains exact decimal text
original period and newVoucherCount; retry does not consume later new sources
original period, CLOSED status and committed version

apReceipt: company finance scope (finance:view:all or explicit super administrator)
authorization.lossOfWrite: An actor retaining the receipt read authority can read their original result or seal their exact unwritten original request, but cannot retransmit its business mutation without current write authority.
authorization.lossOfRead: Do not display a private result; preserve unresolved local command state for authorized recovery.

unwrittenCancellation.path: Append /cancel to that domain's original receipt URL
unwrittenCancellation.identity: All fields are frozen from the original command. The route ID, actor and nested requestId must agree; domain method/path whitelist is checked. Legacy and document adapters keep their established typed checks; new configuration adapters can seal the exact original incomplete/null object without replacing it with defaults.
unwrittenCancellation.transaction: Use the same original request lock and fingerprint. A committed original wins and returns SUCCEEDED. Otherwise append an immutable CANCELLED_UNWRITTEN receipt with result.cancelled=true in the same existing row/table.
unwrittenCancellation.lateWrite: A later original mutation returns its CANCELLED_UNWRITTEN receipt and never executes business work. Different body/actor cannot reuse the original ID.
unwrittenCancellation.lostReply: GET the same receipt or retry the same cancellation; never manufacture another original request ID.
unwrittenCancellation.rollback: A rolled-back cancellation has no receipt and cannot claim to prevent a later write.
unwrittenCancellation.clientAfterCancellation: Retain all original business input. Do not auto-generate/replay a new command. The user explicitly reviews current version/stateFingerprint, adopts only the new CAS state and clicks save before a fresh ID is created.
unwrittenCancellation.legacySuccess: Older successful candidate envelopes are decorated as SUCCEEDED in responses without rewriting their stored bytes.

configurationInputShape.wire: HTTP JSON paths and normal body fields are unchanged. A shared exact WireCommand decoder retains the supplied object; no second journal or lifecycle is introduced.
configurationInputShape.casAndFlags: New expectedRevision/expectedVersion and Boolean choices are boxed. Missing/null required fields reject inside the original command transaction and create no successful receipt. Explicit zero and false remain valid values.
configurationInputShape.targets: New GL targetIds missing/null cannot clear; an explicit [] is required. Existing legacy internal replacement semantics remain unchanged.
configurationInputShape.malformed: Strings cannot be coerced into Boolean/CAS values, nor fractional numbers into integral versions; malformed types return 400 before writes. Semantically missing required input returns the existing 422 validation response.
configurationInputShape.compatibility: Valid old typed JSON/hash bytes remain unchanged; responses retain exact new raw bodies. An original receipt with a different raw shape cannot be reinterpreted as the caller's outcome.
configurationInputShape.termination: The owner retaining the original read authority can seal the precise original null/missing object. Its late matching request returns the tombstone without business work; a different object cannot reuse the ID.

bindingCas: Each listed LineBinding exposes stateFingerprint over line key, confirmedZero and sorted persistent target UUIDs. New replacements freeze and check expectedFingerprint under the existing hierarchy/binding locks. Names and current amounts are not binding identities.
validationOwner: server/src/test/java/com/uten/imp/businesschain/FinanceConfigurationCommandsPostgresTest.java and FinanceConfigurationWirePostgresTest.java; distinct final outcomes are in source-server-verification.json
